'''Kōtai Jingū''' (皇大神宮) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} that enshrines {{ill|Amaterasu|ja|天照大御神|lt=Amaterasu Ōmikami|lt=Amaterasu-ōmikami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Amaterasu|13=User:Immanuelle/Amaterasu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q455602}}. 

The Main shrine is the {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|ja|皇大神宮}} of [[Ise Grand Shrines]] and shrines with the same name are Branch shrines of that shrine. Similar to shrines called {{ill|Daijingū|ja|大神宮}}. While {{ill|List of Jingū|en|List of Jingū|qid=Q120680118|lt=Jingu}} is a highly prestigious title limited to only a few shrines. Kotai Jingus and Daijingus (皇大神宮 and 大神宮) are often much less prestigious and have that title by virtue of being branch shrines of a highly prestigious shrine
